test_name: Verify Navigation to API Documentation and Detailed Endpoint Information
description: This test validates that the user can navigate to the API Documentation page, explore available API endpoints, and view detailed information about a specific endpoint.
steps: Locate and click on the 'roost.ai' logo to navigate to the API Documentation page.
Verify that the API Documentation page loads successfully.
Locate the navigation menu for API endpoint categories on the API Documentation page.
Select the 'Create Test App' endpoint from the menu.
Verify the endpoint details are displayed, including the HTTP method (POST), description, request parameters, and response schemas.
Scroll to the 'Get All Tests' endpoint in the documentation.
Verify the endpoint details for 'Get All Tests', including filters and expected responses.
expected_results: User is successfully navigated to the API Documentation page.
All available API endpoints are listed in the navigation menu.
The details of the selected API endpoint are displayed, including method, URL, request/response schemas, and description.
edge_cases: User clicks on the 'roost.ai' logo but the page fails to load due to a network issue.
The API Documentation page loads, but the navigation menu for endpoints is missing.
User selects an endpoint, but the endpoint details fail to load.
The displayed API endpoint details contain incorrect or outdated information.
The page fails to render properly on different browser versions.
data_requirements: A valid URL for the homepage.
A valid URL for the API Documentation page.
A navigation menu listing available API endpoints.
Detailed information for each API endpoint, including request/response schemas.
Descriptions of each API endpoint's functionality.
dependencies: The 'roost.ai' logo must be clickable and linked to the correct page.
The API Documentation page must be live and accessible.
The navigation menu for API endpoints must be functional.
Endpoint details must be configured and available in the backend.
The user must have access to the page without authentication.
api_interactions: No direct API calls are expected for this test scenario.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the API Documentation page.
Time taken to load endpoint details after selection.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that all navigation elements are accessible via keyboard.
Verify that text descriptions for endpoint details have sufficient contrast.
Check that the page structure follows semantic HTML for screen readers.
